C1010.title: Professional 'Gold Farming' Players and Studio Ecosystems in Popular Games
C1010.summary: A December 2021 report noted that many games with free-trading systems had professional gold farmers who monetized by acquiring and selling game resources. Using games such as Jian Wang 1: Gui Lai as examples, the article discussed trading and income calculations around resources such as silver notes, reflecting a resource monetization ecosystem among ordinary players, gold farmers, and studios under open trading mechanics.

references.title: Even Terrible Players Can 'Earn Over 10,000 Monthly'? Exposing the Game 'Gold Farmers'
